title: LocalAI/ui.json
description: How LocalAI looks for this user.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: system follows the setting of your device.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: A colour such as #3b82f6 for buttons and links. Empty keeps the default. It must keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 against the page in the theme in use; a fainter colour is not used and the default shows instead.

density.title: Density
density.description: compact shows more on one screen.

look.title: Look
look.description: The font, the corners and the look of messages and code. Only the values of each list; there is no CSS.

font.description: The font of messages and the message box. default is Geist.

radius.description: The corners of cards, buttons and messages. soft is the default.

bubble.description: How your own messages look in a chat. card is the default.

messageWidth.description: How wide a chat is: narrow 640 px, medium 760 px (default), wide 920 px, full the whole window.

codeTheme.description: The colours of code in a chat, all from the theme: auto (default), mono (no colours), vivid (more colours), ink (a block in the inverse colours of the theme).

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: The model a new chat starts with. Kept from older versions: used only when defaults.json has no chat. Set the chat default in defaults.json.

homeBackground.title: Home background
homeBackground.description: The look behind the Home page: a colour, a gradient or a picture from your files. Layers stack in that order. Only Home changes.

gradient.description: A linear gradient between two colours.

angle.description: Degrees. 180 runs from top to bottom.

image.description: The path of a picture in your files, without a leading slash, such as Pictures/sky.jpg. A png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif or avif file. No .. and no address.

fit.description: cover fills the page; contain shows the whole picture.

opacity.description: How strong the background is, 0 to 1. Default 1.

overlay.description: A veil in the colour of the theme that keeps the text readable, 0 to 1. Default 0.55 for a picture, 0.35 for a gradient, 0 for a colour.

chatBackground.title: Chat background
chatBackground.description: The look behind the chat view: a colour, a gradient or a picture from your files. Layers stack in that order. Only the chat changes.

gradient.description: A linear gradient between two colours.

angle.description: Degrees. 180 runs from top to bottom.

image.description: The path of a picture in your files, without a leading slash, such as Pictures/sky.jpg. A png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif or avif file. No .. and no address.

fit.description: cover fills the page; contain shows the whole picture.

opacity.description: How strong the background is, 0 to 1. Default 1.

overlay.description: A veil in the colour of the theme that keeps the text readable, 0 to 1. Default 0.8 for a picture, 0.6 for a gradient, 0 for a colour.

strings.title: Text
strings.description: Your own text for a few labels of the app, by key. Only the keys listed here can change: the text of security, permission and consent prompts cannot. A text may use only the placeholders of its key, written as {name}.

home.headline.description: The big line at the top of Home, when home.json has no headline. Placeholders: {user.name}, {time_of_day}, {date}.

composer.placeholder.description: The hint in an empty message box when a model is chosen. Placeholder: {model}.

chat.empty.title.description: The headline of an empty chat, when persona.json has no emptyChat title. No placeholders.

nav.newChat.description: The name of the New chat button. No placeholders.

nav.home.description: The name of Home in the sidebar. No placeholders.

nav.recentChats.description: The title of the recent chats in the sidebar. No placeholders.

nav.allChats.description: The name of All chats in the sidebar. No placeholders.

pinnedPages.description: Pages shown in the sidebar. Pages come in a later release.
